sources: Owner-approved Saraswati twin cities plan, 14 November 2026
name: The Cool Side of the Brick

levels.entry: The exposed brick feels warm; the inner face is cool.
The unroofed rooms keep a patch of shade all afternoon.
The planted rooms use old walls as shelter, with the drain kept outside their roots.
A roof is not the only useful part of a house. The gardener has kept what the plants need.
